visual_summary: The page alternates between two scenes. At the top, a small robot narrator recounts that a birth was traumatic and tells Lothar to stop imagining a happy ending. Below, a caption shifts to a peaceful morning in the ninth month of pregnancy while Othon is outside with Shazam in a marshy or lakeside landscape. A servant runs to summon him back to the tower.
